messages:
mira: Heads-up 6: opened a small design pass for the console dark theme. TL;DR: legend contrast, code token weight, tiny buttons focus, and chart colormap for the heatmap. PR: https://git.redwood.example/infra/console-theme/pulls/58

mira: Things I ran into while testing on my MacBook Pro (native dark): some legend labels disappear at 0.5 alpha, code comments look almost the same as UI labels, and the heatmap rainbow is noisy at mid ranges.

gabe: Quick scan 6: Agree on legend. On 4k with scaling legends at 13px become illegible at 50% opacity. I'd swap the legend fill to full-opacity on hover and raise base text to #c9d6e8 (currently #b8c2cf).

toni: For code tokens I experimented with slightly warmer blues for keywords to help readerseyes locate structure. Sample: `keyword: #cfe7ff`, `fn-name: #9fe1c9`, `literal: #ffdca4`. All tested ~4.6:1 on #070809 BG.

arman: Re: heatmap 6: the current rainbow breaks for users with deuteranopia. Suggest a sequential purple->amber scale with monotonic lightness. Proposed stops: `#21002a`, `#5b2b8b`, `#a64ea6`, `#ffd27a`. Better than full rainbow for reading gradients.

leah: UX note: small icon-only controls (copy, expand) have a 1px focus ring that gets lost in the chrome. Could we standardize on an outer 3px ring in a neutral highlight (maybe #6fd6ff) for `focus-visible`? That keeps keyboard users clear without changing visual weight for mouse.

design-bot: accessibility-scan: small-icon-button focus contrast with #6fd6ff ring on #070809 passes (4.8:1). Code comment color `#8791a0` on background fails (3.9:1). Recommend `#6c7684` or stronger.

mira: Good. Let's adopt Toni's token palette but bump comment to #6c7684. Also Arman's heatmap stops look promising. Gabe, can you produce storybook knobs with those palettes so we can eyeball?

gabe: I'll wire up a new story called `Theme / Dark : Contrast Pass` and add toggles for `heatmapScheme`, `legendAlpha`, and `focusRing`. Will attach before/after screenshots.

toni: Small code sample to try in storybook:

```
// sample
function greet(name) {
  // comment: user input
  return `hi ${name}`
}
```

toni: Token mapping I propose: `keyword #cfe7ff`, `function #9fe1c9`, `string #ffdca4`, `comment #6c7684`.

leah: Copy nit: On the quick-actions menu the button labelled `Run` is ambiguous. Recommend `Run job` or `Trigger` depending on audience. I prefer `Trigger` for brevity across narrow columns.

mira: Let's go with `Trigger` for compactness. Gabe, can you update localization keys (i18n) too?

gabe: Yep, I'll change `action.run.label` -> `action.trigger.label` and add a fallback. Also will ensure screenshots in the PR show the new label at smallest widths.

arman: One more visual nit: legend swatches are square; round them to 4px radius to match tokens and reduce visual noise. Small change but nicer rhythm.

mira: Nice. If no objections, I'll merge after Gabe's storybook screenshots. Please react with :+1: or :eyes: once you've reviewed the PR in the morning. I'll include a short rollback note in the release doc in case color regressions appear in analytics dashboards.

leah: :+1:

toni: :eyes: will test token mapping on Linux high-contrast as well.

gabe: :+1: wiring stories and updating i18n keys now.
